name: 76011 · Arlington, TX
findings: ZIP 76011 (Arlington) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76011 (Arlington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 76011 (Arlington) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
